policy.claimScope: Chromium-only evidence; Firefox and WebKit are EXPLICITLY OUT OF SCOPE by maintainer decision (well-known-browser policy). The compatibility matrix narrows the claim accordingly.

policy.retryQuarantine: No automatic retries: a consistent failure is a failure. Flaky harness steps must be fixed or quarantined with an owner + review date in this file.
